levels.name: 1 · Spain
levels.plain: Laws for the whole country: who may build, what every building must meet (safety, health, accessibility, noise, energy), the right to housing, and how owners of one building share it.

levels.name: 2 · Catalonia
levels.plain: Catalan laws: what makes a dwelling habitable (sizes, heights, light, air), the right to housing in Catalonia, and the urban planning law; plus two circulars that explain how the habitability rules are read.

levels.name: 3 · Metropolitan plan (PGM)
levels.plain: The metropolitan plan of the Barcelona area and its changes: where housing is allowed on a ground floor, how many dwellings fit in a plot, and the metropolitan building and renovation ordinances.

levels.name: 4 · Barcelona
levels.plain: The city's own guide to turning a ground-floor shop into a home: what the Ajuntament checks.

docs.title: Ley 38/1999, de Ordenación de la Edificación
docs.plain: The Building Act: who is responsible for a building (owner, architect, builder) and the basic quality every building must have.

docs.title: Real Decreto 314/2006, Código Técnico de la Edificación (Parte I)
docs.plain: The Technical Building Code: the general part that says which technical rules (the DB documents below) apply, also to works on existing buildings.

docs.title: CTE Documento Básico SUA: Seguridad de utilización y accesibilidad
docs.plain: Safety in use and accessibility: corridors, doors, steps, falls, and access for people with reduced mobility.

docs.title: CTE Documento Básico HS: Salubridad
docs.plain: Health: indoor air and ventilation (HS 3), damp, water supply and drainage, waste.

docs.title: CTE Documento Básico SI: Seguridad en caso de incendio
docs.plain: Fire safety: escape routes, fire separation from the rest of the building, materials.

docs.title: CTE Documento Básico HR: Protección frente al ruido
docs.plain: Noise: how well walls and floors must block sound between a home and its neighbours or a shop.

docs.title: CTE Documento Básico HE: Ahorro de energía
docs.plain: Energy: insulation, heating and cooling demand, renewable energy.

docs.title: Real Decreto Legislativo 7/2015, Ley de Suelo y Rehabilitación Urbana
docs.plain: Land and urban renovation: owners' duties to keep buildings in good state, and renovation of existing city areas.

docs.title: Ley 12/2023, por el derecho a la vivienda
docs.plain: The Right to Housing Act (2023): housing as a right, social and affordable housing, empty homes.

docs.title: Ley 49/1960, sobre propiedad horizontal
docs.plain: Horizontal Property Act: how the owners of flats and shops in one building decide together (a change of use may need the community's agreement).

docs.title: Decret 141/2012, condicions mínimes d'habitabilitat dels habitatges i cèdula d'habitabilitat
docs.plain: THE habitability decree: minimum sizes of a dwelling and its rooms, ceiling heights, façade, windows, light and ventilation. Annex 4 says which rules apply when a shop becomes a home.

docs.title: Circular 10/2025, Agència de l'Habitatge de Catalunya
docs.plain: How the habitability office reads the decree on direct light (an interpretation, not a law).

docs.title: Circular informativa 8, Agència de l'Habitatge de Catalunya
docs.plain: Another interpretation note of the habitability office (not a law).

docs.title: Llei 18/2007, del dret a l'habitatge
docs.plain: The Catalan Right to Housing Act: quality of dwellings, empty homes, social housing.

docs.title: Decret llei 50/2020, de mesures urgents per estimular la promoció d'habitatge amb protecció oficial
docs.plain: Urgent measures for protected housing; among others it repealed part of the habitability decree.

docs.title: Decret legislatiu 1/2010, Text refós de la Llei d'urbanisme
docs.plain: The Catalan planning law: zoning, licences, changes of use.

docs.title: Modificació del PGM: art. 225 de les normes urbanístiques, ús d'habitatge en planta baixa
docs.plain: Where a ground floor may be a home: art. 225.7 allows ground-floor housing in street-line zones, with open space in front.

docs.title: Modificació del PGM: nombre màxim d'habitatges per parcel·la a Barcelona
docs.plain: How many dwellings fit in a plot in Barcelona (one per 80 m² built), and the minimum size and façade of a dwelling.

docs.title: Modificació del PGM per a l'obtenció d'habitatge assequible (B1600, 2018)
docs.plain: Affordable housing in the consolidated city (30 % rule). Its final provision two was annulled by the court (next document).

docs.title: Acord de 31/5/2022 sobre la sentència del TSJC (MPGM B1600)
docs.plain: The court ruling on the B1600 change, as recorded by the planning commission.

docs.title: Ordenances metropolitanes d'edificació
docs.plain: Metropolitan building ordinances: heights, patios, projections and other building details.

docs.title: Ordenances metropolitanes de rehabilitació
docs.plain: Metropolitan renovation ordinances: what existing buildings must meet when they are renovated.

docs.title: Informació bàsica per a consultes sobre canvi d'ús de locals a habitatge (Ajuntament de Barcelona, 2025)
docs.plain: The city's guide: every rule it checks before a shop can become a home (guidance, not a law).
